title.en: MIT reprogrammed immune cells inside mice. Could the body become the factory?
title.zh: MIT在小鼠体内改造免疫细胞，身体能否成为工厂？

summary.en: A nanoparticle approach may simplify cell manufacturing. Encouraging mouse results do not establish a treatment for people.
summary.zh: 纳米颗粒方法或可简化细胞制造；小鼠结果令人期待，却尚非人类疗法。

title.en: Lando Norris joins the team owners. Do 36 cars mean a wider road to F1?
title.zh: 诺里斯加入车队老板行列，36辆赛车能否拓宽通往F1之路？

summary.en: LN4 Fusion and Invicta join an expanded 2027 Formula Regional grid. More places do not establish cheaper access or guaranteed promotion.
summary.zh: LN4 Fusion与Invicta加入扩容的2027区域方程式；席位增加，并不等于费用降低或保证晋级。
